portraits.name: 芬妮的回声
portraits.shots: S13 / S14 / S18（最重要，出场最多）
portraits.screen_box: S13 在右侧（x 1080–1840，色带在右）；S14、S18 中被转成**金色点阵字符**做虚影
portraits.prompt_zh:
以附带的参考图为准，保持角色的脸型、发型、帽子、服装和配饰一致。
日系二次元角色立绘，三色海报风格：只用纯黑、纯白和一个主色金 #FFC24A，不要其他颜色、不要渐变；
硬边赛璐璐阴影，大面积纯白高光，阴影是平涂的纯黑块，线条利落；头发分成大块的黑白，带少量主色反光；
半身或三分之四身构图，人物占画面高度约90%，底部自然裁切；
透明背景（不能透明就用纯 #00FF00 绿色背景），没有文字、水印、边框、地面阴影或其他人物。
芬妮朝画面左侧，三分之四侧身，膝盖以上。一手食指指向左前方，另一手把放大镜举到眼前，透过镜片露出一只放大的眼睛。俏皮自信的表情，嘴角上扬，像正在喊"搜索，解析，确定！"。剪影要清楚，四肢和身体分开。
portraits.prompt_en:
Match the attached reference images: same face, hairstyle, hat, outfit and accessories.
Anime character illustration in a three-colour poster style: only pure black, pure white and one accent colour golden yellow #FFC24A; no other colours, no gradients.
Hard-edged cel shading, large pure-white highlight areas, flat solid-black shadow shapes, crisp linework; hair rendered as big black and white masses with a few accent-colour glints.
Half-body or three-quarter framing, figure fills ~90% of the frame height, cropped naturally at the bottom.
Transparent background (or flat pure #00FF00 if transparency is unavailable); no text, no watermark, no frame, no ground shadow, no other characters.
Fanny facing screen left, three-quarter view, knees-up. One index finger points forward-left; the other hand holds a magnifying glass to her eye, one big magnified eye showing through the lens. Playful, confident grin, as if shouting "Search, parse, confirm!". Clear silhouette, limbs separated from the body.

forms.prompt_zh:
一张小木桌，**一条腿明显比别的短**，桌面微微倾斜。单个物体的扁平插画，居中，占画面约75%。三色海报风格：只用纯黑、纯白和青色 #4FC3FF，不要其他颜色、不要渐变；
粗而干净的轮廓线，大块平涂，硬边阴影；造型简单、一眼能认出；
物体身上带一个小小的"芬妮特征"：桌面一角放着一顶小小的白色帽子，配棕褐色帽带；透明背景，没有文字、水印、边框或地面阴影。

物体身上带一个小小的"芬妮特征"：番茄蒂摆成一个"007"的形状；透明背景，没有文字、水印、边框或地面阴影。
forms.prompt_en:
Flat illustration of a single object, centred, filling ~75% of the frame. Three-colour poster style: only pure black, pure white and cyan #4FC3FF; no other colours, no gradients.
Bold clean outlines, large flat fills, hard-edged shadows; simple, instantly recognisable shape.
The object carries one small "Fanny" detail: its stem leaves arranged like "007". Transparent background; no text, no watermark, no frame, no ground shadow. Object: 一颗多汁的番茄，切开一半，汁水溅出

covers.prompt_zh:
以参考图为准，保持两个角色的长相、帽子和服装一致。横版16:9主视觉。
画面正中一道竖直的发光细线，把画面分成两个"时代"：左半边是1983年琥珀色单色CRT显示器的质感（扫描线、屏幕曲面、橙黄色字符、粗颗粒），
右半边是2026年OLED屏的质感（纯黑底、锐利的白色和金色、干净的界面线条）。
左侧：邦妮（银白头发、深灰宽檐帽、粉紫眼睛）侧身朝右伸手，另一只手里攥着一个苹果；她身上被琥珀色的字符和像素点覆盖。
右侧：芬妮（金发、白色帽子带棕褐色帽带、蓝眼睛、藏青外套、红领结）侧身朝左伸手，一只手拿着放大镜；她的轮廓边缘正在散成金色的点阵字符。
两人的指尖隔着发光线只差一点点。背景里飘着代码碎片和搜索框。
三色海报式人物上色：黑、白各加角色自己的主色；整体冷暗，只有粉紫和金两处高饱和色。
画面上方留出约20%的空白放标题，不要画任何文字。
covers.prompt_en:
Match the reference images for both characters. 16:9 key visual.
A thin vertical line of light splits the frame into two eras: the left half looks like a 1983 amber monochrome CRT (scanlines, curved glass, orange-amber characters, coarse grain); the right half looks like a 2026 OLED screen (true black, crisp white and gold, clean interface hairlines).
Left: Bonnie (silver-white hair, dark grey wide-brim hat, pink-violet eyes) in profile facing right, reaching out, an apple in her other hand, overlaid with amber characters and pixels.
Right: Fanny (blonde, white hat with a tan band, blue eyes, navy coat, red ribbon) in profile facing left, reaching out, a magnifying glass in her other hand, her outline dissolving into gold dot-matrix characters.
Their fingertips almost touch across the line. Floating code fragments and a search bar in the background.
Characters in a three-colour poster style (black, white and each character's own accent). Cold, dark overall; pink-violet and gold are the only saturated colours.
Leave ~20% empty space at the top for a title. No text anywhere.

covers.prompt_zh:
以参考图为准。竖版海报：上半部分是一台老式琥珀色CRT显示器，屏幕里映出邦妮的像素小人；
下半部分是一块纯黑OLED屏，屏上是芬妮的三色海报风立绘，她的轮廓正在散成金色点阵。
两块屏幕之间是一条搜索框，里面的输入光标在闪。冷暗色调，只有粉紫和金两处高饱和色。不要画任何文字。
